description: This file defines the Online controller class for the admin report section in an OpenCart project. It handles displaying online customer data, including listing, filtering, and pagination.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for managing online customer reports in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the online report page with header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of online customers.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of online customers with filtering and pagination.
